FileSystemManager.unlink(Object object)

Delete files (Folders cannot be deleted,Minimum version: 23.6.0).

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
filePath String Yes Path of the file to be deleted. (Local path, which can only be in the usr directory. It can be a relative directory, but the final real path cannot be outside the usr directory.It is not allowed to delete temporary paths and cache path files)
success Function No Callback function that is successfully invoked.
fail Function No Callback function that fails to be invoked.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

Sample Code

const fs = ma.getFileSystemManager();
fs.unlink({
  filePath: `${ma.env.USER_DATA_PATH}/testFile.txt`,
  success(res) {
    console.log(res);
  },
  fail(res) {
    console.error(res);
  },
});

Tips

  1. The value of filePath must ensure that each level in the path is a folder. Otherwise, the interface returns the exception information no such file or directory ${filePath}.
